name: TheFaithApp
shortDescription: UK-operated church-management and mobile-app platform for members, content, events, communications and third-party online giving.
suitableContexts: Churches seeking a free entry tier for a broad member-facing platform
Teams that need sermon, devotional, event and communication tools in a mobile app
Churches able to evaluate a newer UK operator with an international audience

pricing.summary: The supplier advertises a free plan for churches with up to 100 members and paid plans based on church size. Its optional AI add-on is advertised from $15/month; obtain a current order summary for paid platform and UK payment-processing costs.

tiers.label: Free plan
tiers.detail: Supplier says this is available for churches with up to 100 members.

pricing.trialDetails: The supplier presents the small-church tier as free rather than as a time-limited trial.

gdprInformation: The privacy policy names THEFAITH LTD in London, describes payment processors including Stripe, PayPal and Flutterwave, and says information may be processed internationally. Obtain a current data-processing agreement, hosting and sub-processor details, retention schedule, access controls and export process before storing member or donor data.
coreFeatures: Church updates, real-time chat and prayer requests
Mobile apps for iOS and Android
support: Supplier offers a personalised demo booking route

uk-operator.value: Companies House records THEFAITH LTD, company number 15841609, as an active UK private limited company; the supplier terms identify it as owner of TheFaithApp.

free-tier.value: Supplier advertises a free plan for churches with up to 100 members.

payments.value: Supplier says donations are processed by connected third-party providers, including Stripe, PayPal and Flutterwave, rather than storing card or bank data itself.

privacy.value: Supplier privacy policy says information may be processed internationally and identifies its third-party payment providers.

editorial.assessment: TheFaithApp is a newer UK-operated platform offering a notably broad free entry tier: church administration, member-facing content, communications, events, mobile apps and payment-provider connections. Its public material is global rather than UK-specialist, and the product is young, so it should be assessed as a controlled pilot rather than an automatic replacement for established church systems. The payment integrations do not by themselves confirm UK Gift Aid or charity-accounting capability.
bestFor: Small churches seeking a free member-facing platform
Churches that prioritise sermons, devotions, announcements and app access
Teams prepared to conduct a careful privacy and payment-integration review
strengths: Free plan advertised for churches with up to 100 members
Broad member, content, communication and mobile-app scope
Supplier identifies third-party payment processors and offers a demo
limitations: Paid platform pricing is not clearly published in GBP
The platform serves churches worldwide and supplier privacy information allows international processing
The reviewed material does not state Gift Aid support, UK payment methods, accounting exports or data-hosting location
New supplier and public mobile-app data disclosures warrant additional due diligence
